lat: tiyebt tajin b l-berquq l-yum
en: I cooked a tagine with prunes today.

lat: ma tiyebtsh l-l7em f l-kuzina
en: I didn't cook meat in the kitchen.

lat: tiyebti l-khodra l d-drari s-sghar
en: You (m.) cooked vegetables for the young children.

lat: ma tiyebtish l-3sha l-bare7 f l-lil
en: You (m.) didn't cook dinner last night.

lat: tiyebti 7uta kbira f l-ferran
en: You (f.) cooked a big fish in the oven.

lat: ma tiyebtish l-gheda l l-3aila dyalek
en: You (f.) didn't cook lunch for your family.

lat: tiyeb t-tajin dyal l-djaj b zerba
en: He cooked the chicken tagine quickly.

lat: huwa ma tiyebsh l-makla f d-dar
en: He didn't cook food at home.

lat: tiybat shorba zwina l l-walidin dyalha
en: She cooked good soup for her parents.

lat: ma tiybatsh l-kosksu had l-jem3a
en: She didn't cook couscous this Friday.

lat: tiyebna l-bid b matisha l l-ftur
en: We cooked eggs with tomatoes for breakfast.

lat: ma tiyebnash l-makla b z-zit dyal l-3ud
ar: ما طيبناش الماكلة بالزيت ديال العود
en: We didn't cook the food with olive oil.

lat: ntuma tiyebtu 3sha mzyan l d-dyaf
en: You (pl.) cooked a good dinner for the guests.

lat: ma tiyebtush l-l7em mzyan had n-nhar
ar: ما طيبتوش اللحم مزيان هاد النهار
en: You (pl.) didn't cook the meat well today.

lat: tiybu tajin dyal l-7ut l l-gheda
en: They cooked a fish tagine for lunch.

lat: ma tiybush l-kosksu had l-3id
en: They didn't cook couscous this holiday.

lat: kantiyeb l-makla dyali f d-dar
en: I cook my food at home.

lat: ma kantiyebsh b z-zit bzzaf
en: I don't cook with a lot of oil.

lat: dima kattiyeb tajin ldid b l-khodra
en: You (m.) always cook a delicious tagine with vegetables.

lat: ma kattiyebsh l-makla mzyan a sa7bi
ar: ما كتطيبش الماكلة مزيان ا صاحبي
en: You (m.) don't cook food well, my friend.

lat: wash dima kattiybi l-ftur bekri
en: Do you (f.) always cook breakfast early?

lat: nti ma kattiybish l-l7em f d-dar
en: You (f.) don't cook meat at home.

lat: kaytiyeb l-makla dyalu kul nhar
en: He cooks his food every day.

lat: ma kaytiyebsh l-gheda m3ana f l-kuzina
en: He doesn't cook lunch with us in the kitchen.

lat: khti kattiyeb l-kosksu kul jem3a
en: My sister cooks couscous every Friday.

lat: hiya ma kattiyebsh l-7ut f d-dar
en: She doesn't cook fish at home.

lat: 7na kantiybu l-3sha dyalna bekri
en: We cook our dinner early.

lat: ma kantiybush b s-skkar f l-kuzina
en: We don't cook with sugar in the kitchen.

lat: ntuma kattiybu l-makla dyal l-maghrib
en: You (pl.) cook Moroccan food.

lat: ma kattiybush l-gheda dyalkum f d-dar
en: You (pl.) don't cook your lunch at home.

lat: huma kaytiybu tajin zwin bzzaf
en: They cook a very good tagine.

lat: ma kaytiybush l-l7em f had l-blasa
en: They don't cook meat in this place.

lat: ghadi ntiyeb tajin dyal l-ghenmi ghedda
ar: غادي نطيب طاجين ديال الغنمي غدا
en: I am going to cook a lamb tagine tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish ntiyeb l-3sha had l-lila
ar: ما غاديش نطيب العشا هاد الليلة
en: I am not going to cook dinner tonight.

lat: nta ghadi ttiyeb l-kosksu l d-dyaf
en: You (m.) are going to cook couscous for the guests.

lat: ma ghadish ttiyeb l-l7em l-yum
en: You (m.) are not going to cook meat today.

lat: ghadi ttiybi tajin dyal l-khodra ghedda
ar: غادي تطيبي طاجين ديال الخضرة غدا
en: You (f.) are going to cook a vegetable tagine tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish ttiybi l-gheda f d-dar
en: You (f.) are not going to cook lunch at home.

lat: huwa ghadi ytiyeb l-3sha l khuh
en: He is going to cook dinner for his brother.

lat: ma ghadish ytiyeb tajin had l-lila
ar: ما غاديش يطيب طاجين هاد الليلة
en: He is not going to cook a tagine tonight.

lat: ghadi ttiyeb shorba zwina l s-sba7
en: She is going to cook a good soup for the morning.

lat: ma ghadish ttiyeb l-makla f l-ferran
en: She is not going to cook food in the oven.

lat: ghadi ntiybu l-gheda dyalna f l-kuzina
en: We are going to cook our lunch in the kitchen.

lat: ma ghadish ntiybu l-l7em had n-nhar
ar: ما غاديش نطيبو اللحم هاد النهار
en: We are not going to cook meat today.

lat: wash ghadi ttiybu tajin dyal l-7ut
ar: واش غادي تطيبو طاجين ديال الحوت
en: Are you (pl.) going to cook a fish tagine?

lat: ma ghadish ttiybu l-3sha l-yum f d-dar
ar: ما غاديش تطيبو العشا اليوم فالدار
en: You (pl.) are not going to cook dinner at home today.

lat: huma ghadi ytiybu kosksu kbir ghedda
ar: هما غادي يطيبو كسكسو كبير غدا
en: They are going to cook a big couscous tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish ytiybu l-makla f l-kuzina
en: They are not going to cook food in the kitchen.
